name: A news take is edited as one
description: One person, one story, one sitting: the video is the argument with everything that was not the argument taken out.
when: the recording is one person covering a piece of news in one sitting — talking to camera, or over their own screen — rather than a stream, a stream highlight or a conversation

then.prompt: Keep the order it was said in: the claim, then what was shown or run, then the verdict. Open on the claim, not on the warm-up, and end on the verdict rather than on the speaker running out of things to say.
